correctionStepsHelp: Follow these three steps so the admin can process your request without follow-up questions.
correctionStep1Body: Include the student's name, session or grade date, and original grade/status. Find these on the Grades page and each session's attendance page.
correctionStep2Body: Send an email or an internal message to the institution. Briefly state the reason, for example a grade of 80 entered as 8 by mistake.
correctionStep3: The admin processes and records it
correctionStep3Body: Each correction is fully recorded: who requested and approved it, when, why, and the original grade. None of your data is lost.
whyLockedBody: Grades and attendance are official records of students' learning progress. The 7-day limit keeps reports to parents consistent, while corrections remain available through an admin.
